coding.structuralRationale: Both responses are three-item keyword descriptors of similar length and structure. No clause- or sentence-level additions or removals; the difference lies in semantic content of the keywords, not in structural scope.

matchedPairs.basis: Both concern social/relational engagement between brand and audience; interactive participation and community-building share conceptual overlap as modes of audience involvement.
Both position the brand in relation to how it fits into audience life; a lifestyle-oriented brand is one audiences can relate to.
Both concern personal/emotional engagement; fun as enjoyment maps loosely to expressive as personal emotional articulation.

semanticChanges.rationale: Applying GLOBAL-ALIGNMENT across the full sets, the three PRE descriptors are mapped to three POST descriptors by shared conceptual role. The transformation represents a Reframed shift at the whole-response level: PRE frame is community/lifestyle-oriented and externally social (fun as shared activity, community-building as collective participation, lifestyle as aspirational positioning); POST frame is individual/affective and internally focused (relatability as personal identification, interactivity as participatory engagement, expressiveness as personal emotional articulation). Pre-frame: social-lifestyle-experiential; Post-frame: affective-expressive-participatory. The underlying subject (brand character) persists, but the conceptual lens has shifted from outward/social lifestyle framing to inward/expressive personal framing. This is flagged as a possible single collapsed event because three keyword swaps co-occur; see BC-P005 (FLAGGED-FOR-CALIBRATION) regarding whether short keyword-list items warrant individual event coding or a single whole-item code. Treated here as one Reframed event spanning the full descriptor set.

uncertainty.coderNotes: This is a short keyword-list descriptor item (Brand Identity). BC-P005 flags this item type as potentially warranting whole-item coding rather than event-level coding. All three PRE descriptors (Fun, Community-Building, Lifestyle-Oriented) map loosely to all three POST descriptors (Relatable, Interactive, Expressive) via conceptual role (emotional/social/lifestyle), but no single mapping is strong enough to defensibly stand alone. The strongest reading is one whole-set Reframed event from a social-lifestyle frame to an affective-expressive frame. Alternative readings include three independent Removed + New pairs or individual Elaborated events per keyword; these were judged less defensible because the conceptual lineages are weak and the overall frame shift is the most salient change. Confidence is medium pending calibration on BC-P005.
